chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
"The prescribed punishment of the umm al-walad is the prescribed punishment of the slave woman if she does not have a child."

key_terms.أُمُّ ٱلْوَلَدِ: A slave woman who has borne a child for her master
key_terms.حَدُّ ٱلْأَمَةِ: The prescribed legal punishment of a slave woman
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: A child, relevant here to the legal status being discussed

ai.seo_question: What is the legal punishment of an umm al-walad in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the legal punishment of an umm al-walad. It states that her hadd is the same as that of a slave woman in the case where she does not have a child.
